title: Gideon and the Crown
author: August Winterbourne
blurb: Tamsin Quintana, the last oath-bound swordspeaker, knows every smuggler's road through the Thornfell mountains. Then the old gods begin answering prayers again — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must reforge a broken covenant between realms, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
